# Ilzam | AI-Native Software Engineer for Founders

> I ship like a team of three, and you pay for one. AI agents handle the typing, I make the decisions and review every change before it ships, and the code is yours. Based in Indonesia, working globally.

## About

Ilzam is an AI-native software engineer. He has shipped 15+ MVPs, led platform rebuilds for 5,000+ user systems, and currently works embedded in a San Francisco AI company, remotely from East Java, Indonesia. He builds with Go, React, TypeScript, .NET, and PostgreSQL. He thinks in systems, not tickets.

## Services

### MVP Build
The first version of your product, designed, built, and shipped to production. AI agents write most of the code while Ilzam makes the architecture calls and reviews every change. A working demo every week. Most MVPs ship in 6-10 weeks, from $2,500.

### Vibe-Code Rescue
For founders whose prototype was built with Lovable, Bolt, Cursor, or a cheap freelancer and is breaking under real users. A security check (leaked keys, open data, missing logins), fixes for the bugs users actually hit, tests on sign-up, payments, and core flows, and an honest fix-or-rebuild call. One fixed price, quoted after reviewing the code.

### Engineer on Retainer
A senior engineer on your team by the month: architecture decisions, code review for your developers or agency, help hiring, and hands-on building on the larger plan.

Pricing (month-to-month, cancel with 2 weeks' notice): Advisor $1,000/month (~8 hours), Tech Lead $3,000/month (~40 hours), Embedded Engineer $5,500/month (~80 hours, includes building). One-off 90-minute Strategy Session: $300. Details: https://ilzam.dev/pricing/
